message.content: Retrieval in LLM agent systems involves managing semantic buffers with learning-augmented cache policies that reuse past experiences matched by embedding similarity. Agent memory leverages fast hybrid retrieval combining vector and BM25 methods with cross-encoder reranking. In academic research, retrieval occurs within a fragmented toolchain where literature discovery forces context switches between separate applications.
